_comment: T-426 slice 4 / T-540 retune / T-564 retaliate-only — the tactical teaching encounter. Drillmaster Hale's straw sparring effigy in the training ring. It reuses the M6 dirge telegraph tech (CombatState.CHANNELING + cast_start/cast_end, T-017) via the 'training_dirge' boss_mechanic: once a trainee engages it, it winds up a slow, well-telegraphed 3s channel (dirge_channel_ticks 60 @ 20Hz). Dealing dirge_interrupt_damage during the window — OR landing a dedicated interrupt (warrior Pummel / mage Counterspell) — BREAKS the wind-up (boss_mechanics emits dirge_end interrupted). training_interrupt.gd detects the break at ability-commit time and credits the q_tut_03 'interrupt' objective to the interrupter (server-authoritative). Deliberately NOT a passive dummy (is_dummy would short-circuit the AI so it never aggros -> never channels): it aggros and melees VERY gently (base_damage 2 => ~3 dmg, ~3% of a L1's 100 HP, small leash) so the lesson is taught by a win, never a wipe. T-540 FIX: training_dirge lands as ONE token hit of dirge_damage AT CHANNEL END (boss_mechanics._tick_training_dirge), not the crypt dirge's per-tick pulse — the old code stacked dirge_damage every server tick across all 60 channel ticks (~120 dmg) and one-shot the L1 mage. dirge_damage 15 = 15% of a L1's 100 HP: a real sting the trainee wants to interrupt, fully survivable if eaten. Moderate stamina (30 => 200 HP) tanks many practice reps yet is killable in reasonable time; the quest only needs a single interrupt so no kill is required. T-560 SAFEGUARD: non_lethal=true — main._apply_mob_events caps every effigy hit (melee AND the token dirge) via mob_data.non_lethal_damage so it can never reduce a trainee below 15% HP. A prior 'T-559 drowning' misdiagnosis blamed water damage; the real killer was the effigy aggroing an idle trainee at the ring and draining 100->0 over ~30s (masked because the recap relay crashed on mob.mob_id and logged 0 damage taken). This flag makes the practice target incapable of a kill regardless of how long a confused new player stands in range. T-564 FIX (portal report #18): non_lethal stopped the KILL but the effigy (spawn 16,10, aggro_radius 5.0) was still auto-meleeing a fresh player idling at Hale (12.5,9.0, ~3.64m away) before the tutorial even started — bad onboarding, and the mob_aggro AGGRO_FLOOR (5.0m, server_config.gd) means a same-level player would ALWAYS be inside proximity range no matter how low aggro_radius is authored, so shrinking the JSON radius alone cannot fix it. retaliate_only=true makes mob_ai._tick_idle skip its proximity-aggro scan for this mob entirely — it now stays passive near the ring no matter how close an idle trainee stands. It still fully engages (and channels the dirge) the instant it takes threat, via the SAME threat-pull check T-070 already runs unconditionally before the (now-skipped) proximity scan — so q_tut_03's interrupt lesson is untouched: a trainee who attacks the effigy pulls it into combat exactly as before. aggro_radius is kept at 5.0 for schema/documentation parity with other mobs but is now inert on this mob (retaliate_only bypasses it).
name: Straw Sparring Effigy
